laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Test dose 100 mg deep gluteal IM; observe for 7 days. Maintenance 200-400 mg every 2-4 weeks. Adjust interval (14-28 days) and dose to clinical response. Note: zuclopenthixol ACETATE (Clopixol Acuphase) is a SHORT-acting depot for acute use — do NOT use as a maintenance LAI.

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~19 days. Steady state in 8-12 weeks of regular dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors (paroxetine, fluoxetine, bupropion) raise levels and worsen EPS — depot kinetics amplify the consequence. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Minimal metabolic burden — a reason FGA depots persist in long-term use despite EPS profile. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: This entry IS the LAI. Oral zuclopenthixol exists but is not in v0.2 registry.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Long depot tail provides natural taper after last injection. Tardive dyskinesia after long-term use is the dominant concern. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Viscous oily solution (vegetable oil vehicle). Deep gluteal IM. Warm vial to body temperature before injection to ease delivery. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
